name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Phishing or C2 Domain
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "credential-stealer"
       or xdm.event.description contains "command-control"
       or xdm.event.description contains "phishing-kit"
       or xdm.event.description contains "phishing-login"
       or xdm.event.description contains "malware-distro"
       or xdm.event.description contains "ransomware-payload"
       or xdm.event.description contains "exploit-kit"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| filter domain != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(domain) as bad_domains,
       count() as bad_queries,
       values(domain) as domain_list
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter bad_queries >= 3 and bad_domains >= 2
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, bad_domains
description: Infoblox DNS query event for a domain matching known phishing-kit, credential-stealer, command-control, malware-distro, ransomware-payload, adware-injector, or exploit-kit keywords.
alert_name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Phishing or C2 Domain
alert_description:
What fired: Infoblox DNS query event for a domain matching known phishing-kit, credential-stealer, command-control, malware-distro, ransomware-payload, adware-injector, or exploit-kit keywords.

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.004 - Application Layer Protocol: DNS (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
